claims.text: The recommended starting dose is 125 mg once daily for 21 consecutive days followed by 7 days off treatment in a 28-day cycle.
Palbociclib inhibits CDK4 and CDK6 and blocks progression from G1 into S phase in ER-positive breast cancer cell lines.

sections.title: Clinical evidence
sections.summary: Prepared from the bundled Ibrance evidence for the no-key demo run.

claims.text: In PALOMA-2, investigator-assessed median progression-free survival was 24.8 months with IBRANCE plus letrozole and 14.5 months with placebo plus letrozole; overall survival was not statistically significant in the prespecified final analysis.

claims.text: IBRANCE is indicated for specified adults with HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced or metastatic breast cancer in combination regimens described in the prescribing information.
The recommended starting dose is 125 mg once daily for 21 consecutive days followed by 7 days off treatment in a 28-day cycle.
Complete blood counts are monitored before treatment, at the beginning of each cycle, on Day 15 of the first two cycles, and as clinically indicated.
